scripts.prepare: command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 && git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 && lefthook install || echo 'lefthook: skipping install (no git repo found, e.g. inside a Docker build)'
scripts.check:spec-drift: cd apps/backend && uv run python -m app.scripts.export_openapi && cd ../.. && git diff --exit-code -- packages/api-spec/openapi.json
scripts.check:client-drift: pnpm --filter frontend generate:api && git diff --exit-code -- apps/frontend/src/api/generated
